answer: Commit the receipt hash, reveal the work after the epoch closes, then let peers grade the reveal. Dilute the payout when peers disagree and vest the rest against four more epochs of work. Assume the attacker is smarter: a commit can be forged, a reveal that survives independent grading cannot, and vesting forces a farm to keep puppets alive for four epochs. Forty identical commits read like one sonnet with the title swapped. Watch the umber ripple of a disagreement travel through the vesting schedule before it touches the balance.
